A '''repulsor crane''' was a construction vehicle. The [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] had a number of repulsor cranes assigned to it to assist in base construction efforts.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
